research.facts:
September 1 Countdown
**Confirmed facts (HIGH confidence):**
- September 1 of junior year is the first date D1 softball coaches can initiate contact with PSAs — applies to Class of 2028
- Today is August 30, 2026 — the window opens in 2 days
- In-person contact window opens September 9 at 7 AM ET
- First-hour coaching calls (before 8 AM on Sept. 1) represent the highest-priority prospect outreach
- Coaches finalize call lists in advance; the order of contact signals recruiting priority
**Source notes:**

research.facts:
Texas 2027 Fall Schedule + Portal
**Confirmed facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Texas officially announced 2026 fall schedule on August 28, 2026
- Six-game fall slate: 5 home (Red & Charline McCombs Field), 1 road (Texas A&M)
- Fall schedule:
- Sept. 29 — Murray State (home, 6 PM CT)
- Oct. 13 — Texas State (home, 6 PM CT)
- Oct. 20 — Temple College (home, 6 PM CT)
- Oct. 27 — McLennan CC (home, 6 PM CT)
- Oct. 29 — UTSA (home, 6 PM CT)
- Nov. 6 — at Texas A&M, Davis Diamond, College Station (7 PM CT)
- All home games are free admission
- Mike White: "will look in the transfer portal again this year to bring in some pieces"
- Teagan Kavan returns (2x WCWS MOP, only player in history to earn it twice)
- 6 of 9 starters from 2026 championship return; Texas loses Reese Atwood and others to graduation
**Source notes:**
- texaslonghorns.com/news/2026/8/28/softball-announces-2026-fall-schedule confirms official fall schedule
- statesman.com/sports confirms portal/recruiting outlook and White's quotes
